name: James R. Stewart
summary: James R. Stewart is a builder: a founder and product manager who has spent his career building financial products at the edge of finance and new technology. He is the founder of Belief Systems, the measurement layer for prediction markets, and a crypto product manager at SoFi. He previously built products at Eigen Labs, StellarFi, Genesis, and BlackRock.
disambiguation: Not to be confused with the actor James Stewart (1908–1997) or other people named James Stewart.
